lines.text: Which war had exactly one casualty? A pig.
June 1859. An American farmer catches a pig digging up his potatoes.
So he shoots it. Problem: that pig belonged to the British.
America sends sixty-four soldiers. Britain answers with warships.
Soon it's four hundred soldiers, eight cannons, and five warships. All for one pig.
Nobody fired a single shot at each other. They just glared for twelve years.
In 1872, a German emperor's committee finally gave the island to America.
One pig dead. Zero winners. Which war was that?

facts.date: 1859-06-15 Lyman Cutlar shot a Hudson's Bay Company pig in his potato patch
facts.troops: US first 64 soldiers, by mid-August 400+ and 8 cannon
facts.ruling: Oct 1872, Kaiser Wilhelm I's 3-person committee in Geneva ruled San Juan Islands American
